# Working RE Magazine

> Working RE Magazine is the leading source for professional news, continuing education, insurance, and business resources for real estate appraisers, home inspectors, and agents.

Working RE Magazine serves the real estate appraisal, inspection, and brokerage industries through OREP (Online Real Estate Professional), offering industry news, continuing education courses, E&O insurance, and professional development resources. The platform covers USPAP compliance, appraisal standards, and emerging technologies affecting the profession.

## Key Topics

- OREP
- Working RE Magazine
- Continuing Education
- USPAP Compliance
- E&O Insurance
- Appraisal Standards
- Real Estate Appraisal
- Home Inspector Training
- Fannie Mae
- Professional Development
- Liability Management
- AMC Resources
- Appraiser Business
- Industry Updates
- Online Courses

## Core Membership & Access

- [Working RE Magazine](https://www.workingre.com): Working RE Magazine homepage for appraisers, inspectors, agents, and professionals.
- [Join WRE](https://www.workingre.com/subscribe): Working RE magazine subscription, membership benefits, and pricing.
- [WRE Online](https://www.workingre.com/wre-online): WRE Online self-paced appraiser and home inspector courses and training.

## Appraiser Services

- [Real Estate Appraiser E&O Insurance](https://www.workingre.com/real-estate-appraiser-insurance): OREP E&O Insurance coverage and resources for real estate appraisers.
- [Appraiser Continuing Education](https://www.workingre.com/appraiser-continuing-education): Appraiser CE requirements, courses, and compliance updates from OREP Education.
- [Appraiser Magazine News](https://www.workingre.com/appraiser-magazine-news-2): Working RE Magazine news covering appraisal industry updates, standards, and trends.
- [State Board Complaints: Consulting Service](https://www.workingre.com/board-complaint-consulting): OREP consulting service for appraiser state board complaints and defense.
- [AMC Resource Guide](https://www.workingre.com/amc-resource-guide): AMC directory and resource guide for appraisers and business development.

## Home Inspector Services

- [Home Inspector Insurance](https://www.workingre.com/home-inspector-insurance): OREP home inspector E&O and liability insurance coverage information.
- [Home Inspector Continuing Education](https://www.workingre.com/home-inspector-continuing-education): Home inspector CE courses and professional development through OREP.
- [Home Inspector News](https://www.workingre.com/home-inspector-magazine-news): Working RE Magazine news for home inspectors covering industry updates and training.
- [Home Inspector Liability](https://www.workingre.com/home-inspector-liability): Home inspector liability management, risk reduction, and loss prevention resources.
- [Home Inspector Webinars](https://www.workingre.com/home-inspector-webinars): Free home inspector webinars on business development, liability, and marketing.

## Educational Content & Training

- [Educational Webinars](https://www.workingre.com/webinars): Recorded educational webinars on appraisal standards, AI, and real estate topics.
- [How to Support and Prove Your Adjustments (7 Hours CE)](https://www.workingre.com/how-to-support-and-prove-your-adjustments-7-hours-ce): 7-hour CE course on appraisal adjustments and Fannie Mae compliance.
- [Adjustments II (CE)](https://www.workingre.com/adjustments-ii-solving-complex-problems): CE course on complex appraisal adjustments, regression, and matched-pair analysis.

## Real Estate Agent & Broker Resources

- [Real Estate Agent and Broker Magazine News](https://www.workingre.com/real-estate-agent-broker-magazine-news): Working RE Magazine news for real estate agents and brokers.
